post.author_description: repeating the same jokes since 2022 | niche Yakuza content creator | most miserable Yakuza fan | slop sommelier | #REMOVEKAGAWA

description.description: A set of four frames featuring characters from a video game in a cinematic setting. The first frame shows a man in a pirate costume with an eye patch, looking over his shoulder against a backdrop of palm trees and a tall building under a sky with falling light streaks. The second frame shows a man in a dark trench coat with another person behind him, under the same sky. The third frame is a low-angle shot of skyscrapers as multiple streaks of light fall through the sky. The final frame shows a character standing alone in the middle of a city crosswalk with cars driving in the background.
